MOD = 998244353

def main():

    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    if k >= n:
        print(0)
        return
    
    fact = [1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD
    
    ifact = [0] * (n + 1)
    def inv_fact(x):
        if ifact[x] == 0:
            ifact[x] = pow(fact[x], MOD - 2, MOD)
        return ifact[x]
    
    ans = 0
    mult = 1
    for i in range(n - k + 1):
        add = mult * pow(n - k - i, n, MOD) % MOD
        add = add * fact[n - k] % MOD
        add = add * inv_fact(i) % MOD
        add = add * inv_fact(n - k - i) % MOD
        add = add % MOD
        ans = (ans + add) % MOD
        mult = -mult
    
    ans = ans * fact[n] % MOD
    ans = ans * inv_fact(k) % MOD
    ans = ans * inv_fact(n - k) % MOD
    
    if k == 0:
        print(ans)
    else:
        print(ans * 2 % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
